badgePromptPrefix: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single collectible badge illustration for Rater & Tracker desktop app. Style: exquisite handmade pencil and softly painted gouache, clean warm sepia contours with tiny natural variation, matte pale buttery yellow and golden ochre fills, warm ivory highlights; sage green only as a small accent. Not photorealistic or 3D. Composition: centered one clearly recognizable subject filling about 68% of a square canvas, generous clean transparent margin, all contours contained, readable at 80px. A subtle imperfect pale yellow watercolor medallion behind the subject, NO hard enclosing border. Real transparent background outside paint, no opaque white rectangle, no checkerboard. Elegant grown-up journal stationery feel, precise silhouette and restrained texture. No words, letters, numbers, name label, logo or watermark. 1024x1024.
promptRule: Badge full prompt = badgePromptPrefix + prompt. Other assets use prompt verbatim.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating background tile for a private offline journaling desktop app Rater & Tracker. Create a square seamlessly tileable wallpaper, delicate hand-drawn pencil doodles on uniform warm ivory cream #faf8ef, inspired by the airy feel of a messaging wallpaper but original. Small scattered four-point stars, curved constellation lines, open books, short pencils, little flags, simple mugs and occasional sage-green leaves. Very sparse, 75% empty space, extremely low contrast pale ochre lines, tiny soft pale yellow watercolor hints, green under 8% of visible marks. Fine natural strokes, elegant and quiet, no central composition, no shading gradients at edges, uniform distribution, opposing edges match exactly. Actual app background, reading text and white cards placed above it; wallpaper must be unobtrusive. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, border, UI or drop shadows. 1024x1024.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: task empty-state illustration in a personal growth journal desktop app. A small open blank notebook with a short ochre pencil resting diagonally across its lower corner, one tiny four-point gold star above and a single small sage-green leaf beside it. Exquisite handmade sepia pencil outlines and light yellow gouache, restrained paper texture contained inside painted areas, warm ivory highlights, mostly golden yellow with minimal green. Clean centered compact composition, generous margin, every object fully visible, readable at 140px wide. Real transparent background, no enclosing badge, no text or scribbled letters, no human, no face, logo, watermark, UI or shadow halo. Square 1024.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: experience ledger empty-state illustration in a private journaling desktop app. A gentle small cluster of THREE differently sized four-point golden stars resting above a softly curling unmarked paper receipt, two thin curved sepia pencil lines suggesting a trace, one tiny sage-green leaf. Exquisite handmade pencil outlines and pale yellow gouache, ivory highlights, yellow as main color and green very small. Centered complete objects with generous clear margin, readable at 140px, airy quiet grown-up stationery feel. Real transparent background, no badge frame, no numbers, text, letter marks, logo, watermark, UI, face or opaque background. Square 1024.
